summary: Backend-only test for LITTLE new features (Daily Prompts, Achievements Engine, AI Caption Magic via Claude Sonnet 4.6) plus regression on existing endpoints. 15/15 pytest cases passed against http://localhost:8001. All 7 caption tones returned valid non-empty short (<200 chars) unquoted single-line captions. /api/prompts/today is deterministic per day_key; /api/prompts/surprise varies across calls. /api/achievements returns exactly 12 badges with correct shape; posting a fresh memory increments total_memories and unlocks first_moment (progress=1, unlocked=true). Existing profile/memories/mood-summary endpoints still work. No MongoDB _id leakage observed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses logger inside generate_caption exception handler, but logger is defined at module bottom (after route registration). It still works because logger resolution is at call-time, but consider moving logging.basicConfig / logger definition above route handlers for clarity.
prompts/surprise uses random.choice which is fine for this scale; no seeding needed.
Achievements are computed on the fly with a single memories.find(); acceptable for MVP scale but consider indexing on user_id if collection grows.
Backend responses correctly exclude MongoDB _id via projection and public_memory helper.
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY loaded from .env; caption endpoint returns 500 with clear message if missing (validated by code path, not by unit test to avoid unsetting the key).
seed_data_creation: Test creates and cleans up one memory for USER_ID=test-little (today's day_key) during the achievements-unlock test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New feature endpoints all green. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py can be reused. LLM caption tests hit Claude Sonnet 4.6 exactly 7 times per full run (one per tone) — keep parametrization tight to conserve credits. Tests run against internal http://localhost:8001 with USER_ID=test-little.
